message.vehiclestudio.how_to_drive: %s: drive · %s: handbrake · %s: horn · %s: lights · %s: get out
message.vehiclestudio.how_to_drive_turbo: %s: drive · %s: handbrake · %s: horn · %s: lights · %s: get out · %s: turbo
message.vehiclestudio.how_to_fly: %s: move · %s: up · %s: down · %s: get out (careful in the air!)
message.vehiclestudio.how_to_fly_turbo: %s: move · %s: up · %s: down · %s: turbo · %s: get out (careful in the air!)
message.vehiclestudio.invalid: The vehicle data could not be read.
message.vehiclestudio.need_creative: Placing a vehicle directly only works in creative or as an operator.
message.vehiclestudio.need_iron: In survival this vehicle costs %s iron ingots.
message.vehiclestudio.no_permission: You are not allowed to modify "%s".
message.vehiclestudio.too_big: The vehicle is too big to send.
message.vehiclestudio.too_many: This world reached the limit of %s vehicles.
message.vehiclestudio.unknown_vehicle: That vehicle no longer exists in this world.
message.vehiclestudio.vehicle_given: You received "%s". Use it on the ground to place it.
gui.vehiclestudio.drive.controls_text: W/S: accelerate and brake or reverse · A/D: steer · Space: handbrake (drifts in corners) · R: turbo (with thrusters) · H: horn · G: lights · Shift: get out · Shift + right click: trunk. Keys can be changed in Options → Controls.
gui.vehiclestudio.drive.cost: In survival it costs %s iron ingots (free in creative)
gui.vehiclestudio.drive.run_over_tip: Hurts the mobs it hits, more the faster it goes.
gui.vehiclestudio.drive.storage: Trunk (Shift + right click to open it)
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.field.name: Name
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.field.parent_to: The part moves and turns together with the part it is attached to (for example, a motorbike fork attached to the handlebar).
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.field.stretch: Stretch the texture on each face
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.hint.fields: Click a field and use the mouse wheel or the ↑↓ keys (Shift: fine · Ctrl: ×5). With no field active, the arrow keys and PgUp/PgDn move the part. The vehicle's front faces -Z.
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.hint.look: The texture is tinted with the color: use white to see its original colors. In the last field you can type any block texture, e.g. minecraft:block/stone.
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.name: Vehicle name
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.no_parts: No parts. Press "+ Cube" to add the first one.
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.no_parts_here: This vehicle has no parts yet. Add them in the Parts tab or pick a template.
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.panel.collapse: Hide the panel for more room (H key)
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.panel.resize: Drag the edge to change the panel width
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.part.add_toolti: Adds a cube on top of the selected part (as its child)
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.part.center_too: Centers the model and puts it on the ground
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.part.delete_too: Deletes the part (Delete key). Its children move to its parent.
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.part.duplicate_: Copies the part and its children (Ctrl+D)
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.part.mirror_too: Creates a mirrored copy on the other side (wheels, headlights, mirrors...)
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.piece_pick: Pick the part from a list. You can also click it in the 3D view.
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.pivot.center_to: Moves the rotation point to the center of the cube
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.preview.drive_t: The wheels roll and turn left and right, and the brake lights come on, so you can see it moving.
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.preview.help: Drag: rotate · Right drag: pan · Wheel: zoom toward the mouse · Click a part: select it · F: fit · H: hide the panel
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.preview.help_be: Drag: rotate · Right drag: pan · Wheel: zoom toward the mouse · F: fit · H: hide the panel
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.preview.lights_: Turns the headlights on in the 3D view.
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.preview.mouse_t: Use the mouse to move, stretch and paint parts directly in the 3D view (M key)
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.preview.reset_t: Centers and fits the model (F key)
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.title: Vehicle editor
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.too_big: Model too big: remove some parts.
gui.vehiclestudio.editor.too_many_propul: Maximum %s propellers and thrusters per vehicle.
gui.vehiclestudio.flight.controls_text: On the ground: W/S accelerate and brake · A/D steer. If it flies: Space goes up · Ctrl goes down · W/S/A/D move and turn. R: turbo · H: horn · G: lights · Shift: get out (careful in the air!). Keys can be changed in Options → Controls.
gui.vehiclestudio.flight.heli_hint: Space to go up and Ctrl to go down; if you touch nothing it hovers. Without a driver it slowly comes down to the ground.
gui.vehiclestudio.flight.need_parts: To fly it needs at least one propeller or thruster.
gui.vehiclestudio.flight.none: No propellers or thrusters yet. Add a propeller to fly or a thruster for the turbo.
gui.vehiclestudio.flight.pick: Pick a propeller or a thruster to change it (or click it in the 3D view).
gui.vehiclestudio.flight.plane_hint: Speed up on the ground and press Space to take off. In the air it slowly sinks without speed; to land, go down with Ctrl and brake when you touch the ground.
gui.vehiclestudio.flight.takeoff: Takes off at %s km/h (raise the top speed in Driving if it cannot reach it)
gui.vehiclestudio.flight_mode.helicopter: It goes up and down on the spot and hovers in the air, like a helicopter or a drone.
gui.vehiclestudio.flight_mode.none.tip: It always stays on the ground.
gui.vehiclestudio.flight_mode.plane.tip: It needs speed to take off and to stay up, like a plane.
gui.vehiclestudio.import.empty: No files yet. Export a vehicle or copy .json files shared by other players here.
gui.vehiclestudio.import.failed: %s is not a valid vehicle file.
gui.vehiclestudio.import.title: Import vehicle
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.body.tip: A normal cube: it can be painted and carry mini-blocks.
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.exhaust.tip: Exhaust pipe: it puffs smoke from the back (or the top if it is tall) while someone drives.
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.light.tip: Headlight or lamp: it shines with the lights on, when braking or always.
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.none.seat: This vehicle has no seats yet.
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.none.wheel: This vehicle has no wheels yet (it can still drive, but no wheels will roll).
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.pick.seat: The chosen part is not a seat.
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.pick.wheel: The chosen part is not a wheel.
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.propeller.tip: Spinning blades: facing forward like a plane or upward like a helicopter. They make the vehicle fly (Flight tab).
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.seat.tip: Where the driver and passengers sit (facing forward).
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.steering.tip: Steering wheel or handlebar: it turns when the driver steers.
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.thruster.tip: A nozzle that shoots fire out the back (+Z). It gives the turbo (R key) and also makes the vehicle fly.
gui.vehiclestudio.kind.wheel.tip: A round wheel inside its cube (axle from side to side). It rolls as you move.
gui.vehiclestudio.library.delete_message: "%s" will be deleted and all of its vehicles will vanish from the world. This cannot be undone.
gui.vehiclestudio.library.duplicate_tool: Makes a copy to create a variant
gui.vehiclestudio.library.edit_tooltip: Open the editor (also double click or Enter)
gui.vehiclestudio.library.egg_tooltip: Gives you the vehicle as an item to place wherever you want. Free in creative; in survival it costs iron depending on its size.
gui.vehiclestudio.library.empty: There are no vehicles in this world yet. Press "+ New vehicle" to create the first one.
gui.vehiclestudio.library.export_tooltip: Saves the vehicle as a .json file to share it
gui.vehiclestudio.library.hint: Drag to rotate · Wheel: zoom · Double click: edit
gui.vehiclestudio.library.import_tooltip: Load a vehicle from a .json file
gui.vehiclestudio.library.new_tooltip: Create a new vehicle starting from a template
gui.vehiclestudio.library.no_selection: Select a vehicle from the list.
gui.vehiclestudio.library.summon_tooltip: Places the vehicle in front of you (creative or operator only).
gui.vehiclestudio.library.title: Vehicle Workshop
gui.vehiclestudio.light.brake.tip: Shines when braking and when the lights are on.
gui.vehiclestudio.light.head: Headlight
gui.vehiclestudio.light.head.tip: Turns on with the lights key (G).
gui.vehiclestudio.paint.clear_all_tip: Removes the hand painting of every part (Ctrl+Z undoes it)
gui.vehiclestudio.paint.clear_part_tip: Removes the hand painting of this part
gui.vehiclestudio.paint.glow_tip: The part is drawn at full brightness even in the dark.
gui.vehiclestudio.paint.hint: You can paint on any part without selecting it first. Paint shows on top of the base color and texture; the eraser removes it. Keys: B brush, E eraser, I picker, M mouse.
gui.vehiclestudio.paint.mode: What do you want to do
gui.vehiclestudio.paint.mode.pixels_tip: Paint on the faces of the parts, pixel by pixel.
gui.vehiclestudio.paint.mode.voxels_tip: Build with one-pixel cubes stuck to the parts: spoilers, bumpers, grilles, stickers...
gui.vehiclestudio.paint.mouse_off: Turn on the brush and paint directly on the model in the 3D view.
gui.vehiclestudio.paint.stretch_tip: The whole texture covers each face of the cube instead of repeating. Great for windows, lights and grilles.
gui.vehiclestudio.paint.too_much: This vehicle has too much paint: erase some before painting another part.
gui.vehiclestudio.parts.solid_tip: Players, mobs and the ground collide with this part. Turn it off for parts you can walk through, like a curtain or a doorway.
gui.vehiclestudio.prop_axis.front.tip: Spins facing forward, like a plane's propeller (turn it 90° for a tail rotor).
gui.vehiclestudio.prop_axis.top.tip: Spins lying flat, like a helicopter rotor or a drone's propellers.
gui.vehiclestudio.propeller.hint: It spins slowly with the engine on and fast when speeding up or flying.
gui.vehiclestudio.seat.chair.tip: Thin seat with legs and a tall backrest.
gui.vehiclestudio.seat.invisible.tip: Only the place to sit, not drawn (when the body already looks like a seat).
gui.vehiclestudio.seat.racing.tip: Low with side bolsters, for karts and sports cars.
gui.vehiclestudio.seat.saddle.tip: Motorbike or bicycle: just a cushion.
gui.vehiclestudio.seats.driver_tip: Whoever sits here drives. If none is marked, the first seat drives.
gui.vehiclestudio.seats.hint: Players sit on the cushion facing forward. When getting in, a player takes the driver's seat if it is free; otherwise the closest one.
gui.vehiclestudio.seats.none_warning: Without seats nobody can get in: add at least one.
gui.vehiclestudio.skin.applied_layout: Skin applied with the vehicle's own layout: %s
gui.vehiclestudio.skin.applied_some: Skin applied: %s. %s new parts have no place in it and stay the same.
gui.vehiclestudio.skin.export_tip: Saves the vehicle's full texture as a PNG so you can paint it in another program and import it back.
gui.vehiclestudio.skin.exported: Skin saved in the vehiclestudio folder: %s
gui.vehiclestudio.skin.failed_write: The skin could not be saved.
gui.vehiclestudio.skin.folder_tip: Opens the .minecraft/vehiclestudio folder, where skins go
gui.vehiclestudio.skin.import_tip: Put a PNG image painted in another program on the vehicle (export its skin first to get the template). Copy it into the vehiclestudio folder first.
gui.vehiclestudio.skin.none: No skin yet. Export the skin to get a template, paint it and import it back.
gui.vehiclestudio.skinpick.empty: There are no .png images in the folder. Download a skin, copy it into .minecraft/vehiclestudio and press Refresh.
gui.vehiclestudio.skinpick.hint: Copy the .png image into the vehiclestudio folder («Open folder» button) and click it. Hover over it to preview it.
gui.vehiclestudio.skinpick.hover: Hover over a file to see it here
gui.vehiclestudio.skinpick.mismatch: Your vehicle uses %s×%s: some parts may not fit.
gui.vehiclestudio.skinpick.no_skin: Your vehicle has no skin yet: the image will be placed with its own layout (the one from "Export skin").
gui.vehiclestudio.skinpick.title: Choose a skin (PNG)
gui.vehiclestudio.skinpick.unreadable: This image can't be read (is it a PNG?)
gui.vehiclestudio.steering.handlebar.tip: A motorbike or bicycle bar that turns sideways, like the steering wheels.
gui.vehiclestudio.steering.wheel.tip: A ring in front of the driver that spins on itself.
gui.vehiclestudio.tab.drive.desc: How it drives: speed, acceleration, brakes, steering, drift and climbing; health, trunk, horn and engine.
gui.vehiclestudio.tab.flight.desc: Propellers and thrusters to fly and to go faster: whether it flies (like a helicopter or a plane), its speed in the air and the turbo.
gui.vehiclestudio.tab.paint.desc: Color, texture, hand painting and mini-blocks of the chosen part.
gui.vehiclestudio.tab.parts.desc: Add and remove parts: body, wheels, seats, steering wheel, lights, exhaust, propellers and thrusters.
gui.vehiclestudio.tab.seats.desc: Where the driver and passengers sit, and what each seat looks like.
gui.vehiclestudio.tab.shape.desc: Position, size and rotation of the chosen part (also with the mouse in the 3D view).
gui.vehiclestudio.tab.template.desc: Start from a ready-made vehicle: car, sports car, pickup, bus, motorbike, kart, tractor, buggy, cart, helicopter, plane, drone or rocket car.
gui.vehiclestudio.tab.wheels.desc: Ready-made reference wheels and everything you can change on each wheel: size, tire, rim and whether it turns when steering.
gui.vehiclestudio.templates.hint: Hover over a template to see it in the 3D view, and click to use it.
gui.vehiclestudio.templates.warning: Choosing a template replaces the current model and settings. Changed your mind? Press Ctrl+Z.
gui.vehiclestudio.thruster.hint: The flame comes out of the back face (+Z) of the part: rotate it to point down, like on a flying car. It is small when idling, normal when speeding up and huge with the turbo.
gui.vehiclestudio.thruster_style.jet.tip: A tube with a cone in the middle, like a jet plane.
A bell that opens backward, like a rocket.
gui.vehiclestudio.tool.brush.help: Click and drag on the model to paint pixel by pixel · -/+: brush size · Click the background: rotate the view
gui.vehiclestudio.tool.color_tip: Brush color: change it in the Paint tab
gui.vehiclestudio.tool.eraser.help: Drag over the model to erase paint (the texture underneath shows again)
gui.vehiclestudio.tool.move.help: Drag the part or its X/Y/Z arrows to move it · Shift: fine step · Click the background: rotate the view · Right drag: pan
gui.vehiclestudio.tool.picker.help: Click the model to copy that color to the brush
gui.vehiclestudio.tool.resize.help: Drag the little squares on the faces to grow or shrink the part · Shift: fine step · Click the background: rotate the view
gui.vehiclestudio.tool.shape_off: Tip: turn on "Mouse" to move and stretch the part by dragging it in the 3D view.
gui.vehiclestudio.turbo.hint: Hold the R key while driving or flying: the thrusters fire harder and it goes faster until the tank runs out (the bar next to the speedometer). 0 % = no turbo.
gui.vehiclestudio.turbo.need_thruster: The turbo needs at least one thruster.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.clear_all_tip: Removes the mini-blocks from every part.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.clear_part_tip: Removes all mini-blocks from the chosen part.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.hint: Mini-blocks stick to the part you click and move with it (wheels and steering too). You can mix sizes on the same part. Ctrl+Z undoes.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.mirror_tip: Whatever you place on one side also appears on the other: on the same part if it is in the middle, or on its pair (wheel, light...).
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.mouse_off: Turn on the mouse and build with mini-blocks directly on the model in the 3D view.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.place_tip: Adds new mini-blocks where you click.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.recolor_tip: Doesn't add new ones: changes the color of the mini-blocks you touch.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.size.four.tip: Four pixels (a quarter of a block): for big shapes.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.size.half.tip: Half a pixel: for fine details. Two fit along one pixel.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.size.one.tip: One pixel: the usual size, like the pixels of Minecraft's textures.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.size.quarter.tip: A quarter of a pixel: for very fine details (screws, grilles, lettering). Four fit along one pixel.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.size.two.tip: Two pixels: to fill big shapes quickly.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.tool.brush.help: Click the model: places a mini-block on that face. Drag to cover a whole layer; another stroke on top adds the next layer.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.tool.eraser.help: Eraser: click or drag over mini-blocks to remove them.
gui.vehiclestudio.voxel.tool.picker.help: Click a mini-block (or a part) to copy its color and size.
gui.vehiclestudio.wheel.bike.tip: Very thin, with lots of spokes.
gui.vehiclestudio.wheel.sport.tip: Big dark star rim, thin tire.
gui.vehiclestudio.wheel.tractor.tip: Huge, yellow rim and V-shaped lugs.
gui.vehiclestudio.wheels.add_four_tip: Four car wheels at the corners (the front ones steer).
gui.vehiclestudio.wheels.copy_all_tip: Copies this wheel's size, colors, rim and tread to the others (each one stays where it is).
gui.vehiclestudio.wheels.hint: Wheels spin around their center. The distance between the steering wheels and the others decides how tight the turns are.
gui.vehiclestudio.wheels.presets_hint: Press one to put it on the chosen wheel (changes its size and look, without moving it). Then you can change everything below.
gui.vehiclestudio.wheels.rim_size_tip: Rim size compared to the wheel (bigger = thinner tire).
gui.vehiclestudio.wheels.steers_tip: Steering wheels (usually the front ones) point where the vehicle is going.
template.vehiclestudio.buggy.desc: Off-roader with a roll cage, drifts
template.vehiclestudio.bus.desc: Eleven seats and lots of storage
template.vehiclestudio.drone.desc: Four propellers; you sit on top
template.vehiclestudio.empty.desc: Chassis, four wheels and a seat
template.vehiclestudio.helicopter.desc: Top rotor, tail rotor and skids
template.vehiclestudio.motorcycle.desc: Two wheels, handlebar and a passenger
template.vehiclestudio.pickup.desc: Big bed at the back for cargo
template.vehiclestudio.plane.desc: Takes off after speeding along the ground
template.vehiclestudio.rocket_car.desc: Sports car with thrusters and turbo (R)
